clues.text: Simon of Cyrene, on his way in from the country, was seized by soldiers to carry it behind Jesus.
Jesus told His disciples that anyone who would come after Him must deny himself and take it up daily.
Pilate had a notice posted on it that read: Jesus of Nazareth, the King of the Jews.
Jesus' mother, her sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene stood near it.
Passersby mocked Jesus, saying that if He were the Son of God, He should come down from it.
Paul wrote to believers in Corinth that its message is foolishness to the perishing but God's power to the saved.
Believers running their race are told Jesus endured it for the joy set before Him, scorning its shame.
